input.content: Retrieve platform list for page six. Also, find user aliases for the Steam ID '76561197998991414'. In addition, get game data for app with ID '730'. Finally, gather card information for the Hearthstone card with slug 'EX1_557'.

tools.name: getplatformlist
tools.description: Fetches the list of platforms with their IDs and names from the API endpoint as JSON.

page.description: Page number to retrieve the platform list from the API.

tools.name: user_aliases
tools.description: Gets a list of user aliases and the timestamps when they were changed.

is_id.description: The Steam ID of the user for whom the aliases are retrieved.

tools.name: gamesdata
tools.description: Fetches data for a specific game using its APP_ID from the Steam Games Data API.

app_id.description: The unique identifier for the game whose data is to be fetched.

tools.name: get_card_by_slug
tools.description: Fetches card information by slug from the Hearthstone API.

slug.description: The slug identifier for the card.

input.content: Retrieve time zones that are in daylight savings time and have a code containing 'EST'.

tools.name: measure_distance
tools.description: Calculates the distance between two geographic locations based on their latitude and longitude coordinates. The unit of measurement for the distance can be specified.

unit.description: Unit of distance measurement. Valid options are 'km' (default), 'mi', 'ft', and 'yd'.

tools.name: timezones
tools.description: Fetch a list of the world's time zones with various filtering options.

offset.description: Filter on non-daylight savings offset in hours.

name.description: Filter as "contains" on timezone name in the chosen language.

code.description: Filter on 3-letter non-daylight savings timezone code (not unique).

timezone.description: Filter on timezone name in English.

daylights_offset.description: Filter on daylight savings offset in hours.

lang.description: Language selection ISO 639-1 two-letter code. Overrides the Accept-Language header. Default is 'de'.

daylights_code.description: Filter on daylight savings letter code (not unique).

fields.description: Select fields to return in the result. Default is 'offset,daylights_offset,daylights,daylights_code,timezone'.

daylights.description: Filter on daylight savings/non-daylight savings time zones (`true` or `false`).

tools.name: get_countries
tools.description: Fetches a list of countries based on various search criteria.

keyword.description: Search countries by keyword. Defaults to 'ind'.

perpage.description: Number of results per page. Defaults to 50.

page.description: Number of results per page. Defaults to 50.
